preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The value of k must be between 1 and 100,000.
The string S must consist only of lowercase characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k > len(S) else True
postconditions.description: If k is greater than the length of S, the output must be '-1'.
The length of the output string must be equal to the length of S minus k.
The output string must be the lexicographically smallest string after removing k characters.
